en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is no problem with, if a man were to get cupping done and he was with sexual impurity’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is permissible for one who has experienced sexual relation to draw blood from his body by means of cupping.’”
